function.name: museum_info_get_info
function.description: Retrieve specific details about museums, such as opening hours and ticket prices. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Maybe they mean "National Museum of American History" or "National Museum of Natural History"? But they said "國家博物館" which could refer to "National Museum" generically. In Washington DC, there is the Smithsonian Institution with many national museums. The user might want the opening hours and ticket prices for the "National Museum" in Washington DC. But we need to clarify which one. Also they want Louvre in Paris.

We can use the function to get info. We need to call function twice: one for Washington DC museum, one for Louvre. But we need to specify location and details.
